The 2001-2013 Gujarat Chief Minister era IS covered on Commons, but NOT in 'Category:Narendra Modi in <year>' — those year categories are almost empty because the files sit in MONTHLY subcategories ('Category:Narendra Modi in September 2013' etc). Walk the monthly subcats. Productive seams found: PIB/GODL-India coverage of National Development Council meetings (2006, 2007, 2011) and Pravasi Bharatiya Divas (2006, 2007); CC BY-SA Flickr coverage of Sanand 2012, Sadhu Vaswani Nursing College Pune 2013 and Van Mahotsav 2013; CC BY-SA World Economic Forum coverage in 'Category:2006/2007/2008/2009/2010/2011 India Economic Summit'. 11 CM-era files harvested, 10 accepted.
